methodologyNotes: Roster of ten high-search built-in dishwasher models across Bosch, Miele, KitchenAid, LG, Samsung, GE Profile, Maytag, and Whirlpool. Each model was independently re-verified against manufacturer product pages (bosch-home.com, mieleusa.com, kitchenaid.com, lg.com, samsung.com, geappliances.com, maytag.com, whirlpool.com), an official Bosch press release (us.bosch-press.com), and reputable retailers/reviewers (AJ Madison, Best Buy, Home Depot, Lowe's, us-appliance.com, Consumer Reports, Reviewed.com). Adversarial fact-check corrections: Bosch 800 price 1449→1499; LG, Maytag, and Whirlpool prices set to null because no single published US MSRP could be verified (only outlet/comparable-value proxies). All ten models confirmed to exist. specKeys: noise_dba (decibels A-weighted), place_settings (max place-setting capacity, whole number), wash_cycles (count of distinct wash programs), third_rack (boolean; for Miele reflects the included 3D cutlery tray), drying_type (string), smart_wifi (boolean), energy_star (boolean), release (string release year). priceUsd is published US MSRP/list in USD, or null where no verified USD MSRP was found. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

products.name: Bosch 300 Series Dishwasher (SHE53C85N)
products.priceNote: List/value price $1,099 at Best Buy and other retailers; frequently on sale near $799–$999
products.provenance: AJ Madison and Home Depot confirm 16 place settings, 8 wash cycles, 46 dBA, standard 3rd rack, PureDry drying, Home Connect WiFi. This 46 dBA front-control 300-series model is NOT ENERGY STAR certified (confirmed; some retailer URL slugs misleadingly contain 'ENERGY-STAR'). Best Buy lists value $1,099.

products.name: Bosch 500 Series Dishwasher (SHP65DM5N)
products.priceNote: MSRP $1,249; sells ~$999 at discounters (e.g. Masters Wholesale)
products.provenance: Verified real and a genuine 2025 launch: Bosch press release dated Aug 22 2025 references SHP65DM5N with Zone Wash and AutoAir; retail promos began July 2025. Home Depot, Best Buy, P.C. Richard confirm 44 dBA, 16 settings, 3rd rack, AutoAir, Home Connect WiFi, Energy Star. MSRP $1,249 corroborated by multiple retailers.

products.name: Bosch 800 Series Dishwasher (SHP78CM5N)
products.priceNote: MSRP $1,499 per multiple retailers (RC Willey, Spencer's, KAM, Yale Appliance)
products.provenance: AJ Madison confirms 16 place settings, 8 wash cycles, flexible 3rd rack, 42 dBA, CrystalDry zeolite drying, Home Connect WiFi, Energy Star. Price corrected from draft's $1,449 to $1,499 — RC Willey, Spencer's TV, KAM Appliances and Yale Appliance all list $1,499. Consumer Reports reviewed this model.

products.name: Miele G 5056 SCVi SF (G 5000 Series)
products.priceNote: MSRP $1,749 per us-appliance.com and Best Buy
products.provenance: Miele USA, AJ Madison, us-appliance confirm 44 dBA, 5 programs (incl. QuickIntenseWash, SaniWash), Energy Star, $1,749, no WiFi. place_settings 16 per Miele USA rating. third_rack=true reflects the included 3D cutlery tray (Original Cutlery Tray). Drying is condensation via stainless tub heat retention. G 5000 series launched 2021.

products.name: KitchenAid 360° Max Jets Third Rack Dishwasher (KDTM404KPS)
products.priceNote: MSRP $1,349 per Lowe's and AJ Madison; some retailers list it as discontinued/limited stock
products.provenance: AJ Madison confirms 16 place settings, 5 wash cycles, 44 dBA, FreeFlex third rack, 50+ wash jets, NSF certified, $1,349. Lowe's shows ENERGY STAR badge. No WiFi on this model. Heated dry via recessed element. Source URL switched from kitchenaid.com vanity URL to the stable AJ Madison spec page.

products.name: LG QuadWash Smart Dishwasher (LDPN6761T)
products.priceNote: No published US MSRP found; LG.com lists no price and retailer pricing is grade/outlet-dependent (open-box/refurb). Draft's $1,049 was a guess derived from a crossed-out outlet figure.
products.provenance: LG.com product page confirmed: 44 dB, QuadWash four-arm, adjustable 3rd rack, Dynamic Dry 2-stage fan, ThinQ Care WiFi, Energy Star. Retailers report 9 wash cycles + 8 options and 15 place settings (Consumer Reports / retailer listings). priceUsd set to null — no verifiable published USD MSRP. wash_cycles (9) noted here though not a specKey. Release date not found → null.
